title: Pasta with Tomato-Based Sauce and Seafood, Ready-to-Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with tomato-based sauce and seafood is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. It contains pasta, a tomato sauce, a mix of seafood (shrimp, mussels, squid) and seasonings. The dish is designed for convenience: 3‑5 minutes of heating and it’s ready to eat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tomato sauce is made from ripe tomatoes, olive oil and basil, giving the dish a bright aroma.
Seafood in the product is usually flash‑frozen, preserving its nutritional qualities until preparation.
The pasta is often produced from durum wheat, which maintains a firm texture after heating.
The meal is ideal for a quick lunch or dinner and can be taken on the go in a thermos.
Several sauce variants exist: classic tomato, spicy chili‑tomato, and creamy tomato.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Seafood and pasta provide complete proteins essential for tissue repair and maintenance.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Tomatoes and seafood contain B12, niacin and riboflavin, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Shrimp and mussels supply omega‑3s, beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: Lycopene
items.content: Tomatoes are high in lycopene, an antioxidant linked to reduced risk of certain diseases.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: The dish contains no added sugars, making it suitable for moderate carbohydrate intake.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to shrimp, mussels or squid may experience severe reactions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared sauces often contain added salt; people monitoring sodium should watch portion size.

items.title: Thermal safety
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave live microorganisms; heat to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Wheat pasta contains gluten, so the product is unsuitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in a microwave (800 W) for 3‑4 minutes, stirring halfway through, or on the stovetop over medium heat, stirring until the desired temperature is reached. Serve immediately, optionally garnished with fresh herbs or grated Parmesan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen product at –18 °C or lower. After thawing (if required) use within 24 hours. Do not keep the heated dish at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
